Chennai Port Launches Direct Container Service to Southeast Asia and China

Chennai Port has launched a new direct container service connecting it to Vietnam, Malaysia, and China. This initiative aims to facilitate smoother container movement and establish regular maritime connectivity between Chennai and Vietnam. The service is expected to enhance trade and logistics operations.
